title: Meta-learning of Gibbs states for many-body Hamiltonians with applications to Quantum Boltzmann Machines
abstract: arXiv:2507.16373v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The preparation of quantum Gibbs states is a fundamental challenge in quantum computing, essential for applications ranging from modeling open quantum systems to quantum machine learning. Building on the Meta-Variational Quantum Eigensolver framework proposed by Cervera-Lierta et al. and a problem-driven ansatz design, we introduce two meta-learning algorithms: Meta-Variational Quantum Thermalizer (Meta-VQT) and Neural Network Meta-VQT (NN-Meta VQT) for efficient thermal state preparation of parametrized Hamiltonians on Noisy Intermediate-Scale Quantum (NISQ) devices. Meta-VQT utilizes a fully quantum ansatz, while NN Meta-VQT integrates a quantum--classical hybrid architecture. Both use collective optimization over a finite set of training parameter values to prepare approximate Gibbs states at held-out parameter values within the sampled parameter domain. translated_title: 面向多体哈密顿量的吉布斯态元学习及其在量子玻尔兹曼机中的应用
translated_abstract: 量子吉布斯态的制备是量子计算中的一项基本挑战，对于从开放量子系统建模到量子机器学习等诸多应用至关重要。基于Cervera-Lierta等人提出的元变分量子本征求解器（Meta-VQE）框架和问题驱动的拟设设计，我们提出了两种元学习算法：元变分量子热化器和神经网络元变分量子热化器（NN-Meta VQT），用于在含噪声中等规模量子（NISQ）设备上高效制备参数化哈密顿量的热态。Meta-VQT采用全量子拟设，而NN-Meta VQT则结合了量子-经典混合架构。两者均通过对有限训练参数值集合进行联合优化，在采样参数域内的留出参数值处制备近似吉布斯态。我们在最高若干比特规模的横向场伊辛模型（TFIM）上验证了我们的方法……
tldr: 该论文提出了两种元学习算法，通过对有限训练参数值集合进行联合优化，在NISQ设备上高效制备参数化多体哈密顿量的吉布斯态，并可应用于量子玻尔兹曼机。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces two meta-learning algorithms, Meta-VQT and NN-Meta VQT, which efficiently prepare approximate Gibbs states of parametrized many-body Hamiltonians on NISQ devices through collective optimization over a finite set of training parameter values, with applications to Quantum Boltzmann Machines.
